newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down amid dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down amid dull trading.

text.p: Pakistan stocks edged down at Monday's close in dull trading, with investors lying low before the June 14 budget for 1997/98 (July-June), dealers said.
"There are no buying orders and no news to drive the market," dealer Dawar Hasan said. "Investors are sidelined ahead of the budget and trading volume has declined sharply."
The Karachi 100-share index fell 2.29 points, or 0.15 percent, to end at 1,505.67. Losers led gainers 208 to 63. Brooke Bond fell 10 rupees to 160.
